newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade active in the panhandle area Tuesday, with most trading coming before noon as offers backed up, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 33,200 slaughter steers and 20,200 heifers; 75,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 16,000 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 66.00-66.75.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 950-1150 lbs 67.00, couple pens North Plains 67.50. Select, few Choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 66.00-66.50.
Wk to Date - 75,300 Week ago - 2,400 Year ago - 53,100
